mapper.insert: INSERT INTO course_files (original_name, content_type, content) VALUES (#{originalName}, #{contentType}, #{content})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM course_files WHERE id = #{fileId} AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM lesson_files WHERE file_id = #{fileId}) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM lesson_receipts WHERE file_id = #{fileId}) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM task_files WHERE file_id = #{fileId}) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM solution_files WHERE file_id = #{fileId})
